Product description

Flameless Tealights Candles - Realistic Flickering Warm Yello Flame

Battery Operated | Safe for Kids & Pets | Perfect for Home & Holiday Decor

Nancia The Battery Operated Tea Lights are made from the best quality materials. They come with batteries included and last a long time with their flickering light being very realistic. They can be used as decor for many occasions and places.

ealistic Flickering Flame

100% Safe & Mess-Free

ur candles feature a natural, soft flickering effect that mimics the look of a real flame. Creates a cozy, romantic atmosphere for any space.

Is very suitable as a gift for mothers, women, sisters, friends, etc on various festivals

Long-Lasting Battery Operation

We use high-quality batteries that can provide a long-lasting battery life of over 200 hours, meeting your needs for any festival

These battery operated candles are flameless and smokeless. You never need to worry about fire risk. candles made in plastic instead of wax in fact. You also never need worry about that the wind will blow the candles. Just light up the LED candles and enjoy the romantic moment.

Each LED tea light candle uses a CR2032 button cell

Suitable for various festival decorations and home decorations

The tea lights can be used for any many occasions such as: Yoga, Wedding, Party, Birthday, Dinner, Votive, Dating, Valentine’s day, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Halloween, Honeymoon, Proposal, Romantic night, One Special Event and all kinds of Festival Celebration.

      These babies LAST! Recommend highly!
      Reviewed in the United States on December 3, 2022
      Size: 100packColor: Warm yellow
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The holidays are coming, and I love candlelight, but not the danger of fire. I have been using these little tea lights from the discount department store that has the red bullseye, and they last a few days. Since I have been trying to avoid being in stores (for many reasons), I ordered two different kinds of tea lights from Amazon. The first box was smaller, and I have used those up, because they lasted no longer than any other tea lights. But these tea lights? Wow! I put a couple of little glass votives with one light in each in the main floor bathroom over TWO WEEKS ago, and they are still flickering away. They are not quite as bright as they were 2-3 weeks ago, but they are still bright enough.

      I set up a little forest scene on a shelf in my living room, and I have used tea lights to illuminate that; looks like little campfires in the "snow". In the past, I was replacing those tea lights every 3rd or fourth day, which was a pain, because I would inevitable knock over a tree, which would sometimes end up taking out half the "forest". But these little lights, which would have been dim by now (after 4 days), are still going strong, and I have not turned them off; too much trouble to fish them out from behind the trees!

      You will love these lights! They last forever, never get warm, and are pretty bright for tea lights.

      Amazon carries multiple brands of tea lights, and I just randomly picked this brand because of the price per light, and I got lucky, and you will be lucky, too, if you get these.

      I don't usually gush over a product, but these modest little lights are just great.

    About this Item

    • ✅REALISTIC FLICKERING DANCING FLAME | Flameless Tealight Candles-Our flickering LED tea lights cast natural warm light, just like real wax tealights. Classic smooth tealight shape matches all decor styles. Build a warm, romantic atmosphere with zero smoke, no soot and no messy melted wax for indoor use.
    • ✅100% SAFE FLAMELESS DESIGN FOR KIDS & PETS | Battery Operated Tea Lights-Open flame candles bring hidden fire risks, wax stains and burn hazards.These unscented flameless tea lights have no real flame, safe to leave unattended during parties and holiday gatherings.No hot wax to ruin tablecloths, lanterns and furniture. An ideal candle alternative for families, apartments, churches and rental houses that ban open flames.
    • ✅LONG-LASTING BATTERY LIFE & SIMPLE OPERATION | LED Fake Tealights-Each flickering tealight powered by high-capacity CR2032 battery, supporting over 200 hours continuous lighting.Simple ON/OFF switch on the bottom for easy control. Standard universal tealight size fits most glass votive holders, lanterns and candle cups. Ready to use right out of the box.Battery included
    • ✅VERSATILE DECOR FOR ALL HOLIDAYS & EVENTS | Decorative Electric Tea Lights-These bulk LED tealights are must-have home & event decor supplies.Perfect for wedding centerpieces, birthday dinners, Valentine’s Day, Halloween, Christmas, Thanksgiving, anniversary parties.Great for mantels, dining tables, window displays, spa, restaurant and DIY craft decorations.
    • ✅DURABLE PREMIUM SHELL & TRUSTWORTHY SUPPORT | Flameless Candles-Made of lightweight, shatter-resistant premium plastic shell, resistant to fading for long-term use. Neutral unscented design fits every indoor space without strange chemical odor.Available in multiple pack quantities to match your decorating needs. If you receive defective LED tea lights, please contact us anytime for a satisfying solution.

    Product Description

    This set of 100 flameless LED tea lights offers a safe and convenient lighting solution for various occasions. Each tea light measures 1.5 x 1.5 inches, designed to fit comfortably in most votive holders, tea light holders, and luminary bags. Powered by CR2032 button cell batteries that come included and pre-installed, these lights provide approximately 200 hours of illumination per battery. The simple on/off sliding switch allows for effortless operation. These battery-operated candles create a realistic flickering effect that produces a warm yellow glow, establishing a cozy and romantic ambiance without any associated fire hazards, burning risks, dripping wax, smoke, or odors. The flameless design makes them particularly suitable for households with pets, children, or elderly family members. These LED tea lights serve as versatile decorative elements appropriate for bars, birthday celebrations, holidays, restaurants, and numerous other settings where atmospheric lighting is desired.
